title: ASIC: Financial adviser exam preparation guidance (v6.0 · Sept 2026)
note: The official curriculum and learning outcomes plus the reading list. This app's topics are built from it.

title: ASIC: Financial adviser exam resources
note: Exam policy and practice question guidance. Practice questions are in your ACER exam account.

title: ASIC: Professional year
note: Milestones for each quarter. Logbook requirements and completion certificates.

title: ASIC INFO 297: FAQs, Professional year
note: Detail on structured training and work activities. Also covers supervision and ethical dilemmas and the PY plan.

title: Corporations (Work and Training Professional Year Standard) Determination 2018
note: The legal instrument behind the PY. Section 6 lists the outcomes and key competencies.

title: Corporations Act 2001
note: Chapter 7. Part 7.6 covers licensing and professional standards. Part 7.7 covers disclosure and Part 7.7A best interests and remuneration. Also Parts 7.8 and 7.9 (PDS) and 7.10 and 7.10A (EDR).

title: RG 36: Licensing, financial product advice and dealing
note: What counts as financial product advice. General versus personal advice.

title: RG 78: Breach reporting by AFS licensees and credit licensees
note: Reportable situations and the 30-day deadline. Reporting about other licensees' advisers.

title: RG 175: Financial product advisers, conduct and disclosure
note: ASIC's main guide on the best interests duty. Covers SOAs and FSGs and related obligations.

title: RG 246: Conflicted and other banned remuneration
note: What counts as conflicted remuneration and the exceptions.

title: INFO 286: Ongoing fee arrangements and consents
note: Annual consent and renewal windows. Account deduction consent after the DBFO reforms.

title: AUSTRAC: AML/CTF obligations and guidance
note: AML/CTF programs and customer due diligence. Reporting and record keeping.

title: OAIC: Australian Privacy Principles
note: The 13 APPs in Schedule 1 of the Privacy Act. Plus notifiable data breaches.

title: Tax Practitioners Board: Tax (financial) advice services
note: What a tax (financial) advice service is and who can provide one.

title: Tax Agent Services Act 2009
note: Subdivision 50-AA (civil penalties) is the part the exam focuses on.

title: Financial Planners and Advisers Code of Ethics 2019
note: The 5 values and 12 standards with the explanatory statement.

title: Markkula Center: A framework for ethical decision making
note: The utilitarian · rights · justice · common good and virtue approaches. On ASIC's suggested reading list.

title: RG 90: Example Statement of Advice, scaled advice for a new client
note: A worked example of a clear scaled SOA.

title: RG 244: Giving information, general advice and scaled advice
note: Worked examples of scaled advice and the line between general and personal advice.

title: INFO 266: Records of Advice (ROAs)
note: When an ROA can be used instead of an SOA.

title: INFO 267: Tips for giving limited advice
note: Practical tips and an example limited-advice SOA.

title: Financial Advice Association Australia (FAAA)
note: Professional association for CPD and events and member resources. A course it approves for a designation or accreditation counts as one kind of PY structured training.

title: Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA)
note: The external dispute resolution scheme. Its published determinations are useful case studies.

title: Moneysmart
note: ASIC's consumer site. Good for explaining concepts to clients in plain English.
